why_planted: Puts the decoy chain's shared device on the first suspicious alert's routes: the chain is tied to no alert.
The alert as a stream processor with no out-of-order allowance would have computed it: the late credit at the window's edge dropped.
The resting point an arrival-order lookup would report: the debit after this path arrived before its credit, so the lookup stops here.
Gives the benign alert that passes nothing on an onward chain, to the account its owner paid two hours later.
